name: Lava Lake
desc: Plate tectonics running in fast-forward on a lava lake — a divergent flow field tears the black crust open along incandescent ridges, new skin is born there and rafted outward cooling from white-hot through orange to basalt, and where plates collide the margin founders and is swallowed, so the whole surface is created and destroyed forever; rendered as molten blackbody rind, a seafloor magnetic-anomaly age plate, ironbow thermal, or sumi ink.

energy.doc: incandescence + colour/contrast gain, and how hard the crust pulses on the beat

scale.doc: magnification into the lake around x/y — 1 shows the whole surface, 2.6 crops to a single ridge

speed.doc: plate velocity — how fast crust is rafted, cooled and consumed

density.doc: how readily the crust tears: 0 = a few wide plates, 1 = a fine web of glowing cracks

tau.doc: cooling time — how far the skin glows before it goes to basalt, i.e. how wide the age bands read

hue.doc: incandescence hue anchor (24 = orange lava; try 200 for a cryovolcanic read)

x.doc: view centre x (only bites when scale > 1)

y.doc: view centre y (only bites when scale > 1)

style.doc: aesthetic: basalt = molten blackbody skin over a warm textured rind; seafloor = abstracted magnetic-anomaly age stripes, a seafloor-age plate; ironbow = false-colour thermal; ink = sumi tonal wash

seed.doc: plate-driving mode seed (rebuilds the flow field)
